situations.headline: Catalyst Metals: Keillor Resource up 280% on path to 2Moz Reserve at Plutonic Belt

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Catalyst Metals: Keillor Resource up 280% on path to 2Moz Reserve at Plutonic Belt (interest 6, risk 4)

thesis.text: Catalyst Metals is executing a multi-mine buildout across the underexplored Plutonic Gold Belt, converting a centrally located, underutilised 2Mtpa CIL plant into a platform for doubling production to ±200koz pa via six feeder deposits. Keillor's 280% resource uplift after only a year of drilling, following 25 years of neglect, illustrates the low-cost, high-torque exploration upside embedded in the belt consolidation strategy. With nil debt and A$331m in cash/bullion, the company has balance-sheet flexibility to fund development while multiple concurrent Reserve/Resource updates (Keillor, Cinnamon, Trident, Old Highway) could serially re-rate the stock toward its stated 2Moz Reserve and 10-year mine-life targets. Key risks are execution/ramp-up timing and the company's own acknowledgment that prior long-term guidance is now only indicative.
